shadows.name: whimsical-glow
shadows.purpose: Soft, tinted elevation for cards and interactive elements.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #C5A059; color: #4A1E4D; padding: 12px 32px; font-weight: 700; border-radius: 9999px; border: none; letter-spacing: 0.1em; transition: all 0.2s; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #E2CFAB; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 10px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.95); }

components.name: Glass Card
components.html:
Enchanted Pastry

Baked with magic and stardust.
components.css: .ds-card-glass { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border-radius: 2.5rem; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6); padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(74, 30, 77, 0.1); transition: transform 0.3s; } .ds-card-glass:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); }

narrative.overview: The Sugar Plum v2 design system is built to evoke a sense of 'delicious wonder.' It avoids the cold, clinical minimalism of modern SaaS, favoring soft curves, warm tones, and glassmorphic layers.

rules.name: The Rarity Rule
rules.body: Artisanal Sun is a precious metal. Use it on no more than 10% of any given screen.

rules.name: The Frosted Window Rule
rules.body: Depth is created through layers of white transparency and backdrop-blurs.

dos: Do use rounded-[2.5rem] for all major containers.
Do use text-plum for high legibility.
